title: Room on the Broom
author: Julia Donaldson
intro: A friendly witch and her cat fly happily through the sky on their broomstick.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide
Checked by Claude against book reviews (Nov 2026)

questions.q: Who flies with the witch at the start of the story?
questions.clue: This pet purred as they sat on the broomstick.
questions.yes: The witch and her cat fly together at the start.

questions.q: How do the witch and her cat feel while flying on the broomstick?
questions.clue: The cat purred and the witch grinned with a big smile.
questions.yes: The witch and her cat are very happy flying in the sky.

questions.q: What is the first thing the wind blows away from the witch?
questions.clue: She wears this item on top of her head.
questions.yes: The wind blows the witch's hat off her head first.

questions.q: Which animal finds the witch's hat and brings it back?
questions.yes: A helpful dog finds the witch's hat.

questions.q: What does the dog ask for after bringing back the hat?
questions.clue: He asks if there is room on the broom for him.
questions.yes: The dog asks for a ride on the witch's broomstick.

questions.q: What does the witch lose second, after her hat?
questions.clue: She wears this item tied in her long ginger hair.
questions.yes: The witch loses her bow next in the wind.

questions.q: Which animal brings the lost bow back to the witch?
questions.clue: This animal has wings and feathers.
questions.yes: A green bird finds the bow and joins the broomstick.

questions.q: Where does the frog find the witch's lost wand?
questions.clue: Frogs love swimming in this water.
questions.yes: A frog finds the witch's wand in a pond.

questions.q: Why does the witch's broomstick snap in two?

options.text: The frog jumps on the heavy broom

questions.clue: There are too many riders and the frog jumps for joy.
questions.yes: The broomstick is too heavy and snaps when the frog jumps.

questions.q: Where do the animals fall when the broomstick breaks?
questions.clue: They land in a wet, muddy place that rhymes with frog.
questions.yes: The animals tumble down into a muddy bog.

questions.q: Who wants to eat the witch?
questions.yes: A hungry dragon wants to eat the witch.

questions.q: What does the dragon want to have for his tea?
questions.clue: He wants to eat the witch, with chips.
questions.yes: The dragon wants witch and chips for his tea.

questions.q: How do the animals rescue the witch from the dragon?

options.text: They pretend to be a muddy monster

questions.clue: Covered in mud, they stand on each other and make loud noises.
questions.yes: The muddy animals stand together to look and sound like a monster.

questions.q: How does the dragon feel when he sees the muddy monster?
questions.clue: The loud, muddy monster frightens the dragon away.
questions.yes: The dragon is scared of the monster and flies away.

questions.q: What does the witch make in her cauldron at the end?
questions.clue: It has seats for everyone, a nest for the bird and a shower for the frog.
questions.yes: The witch makes a new broomstick with room for everyone.
